title: Success
subtitle: Success 可以指成就、完成一件事、理想結果、正面成效、達標、突破或勝利。 因此替換前要先問：是在說 what was achieved, what outcome occur
description: Success 可以指成就、完成一件事、理想結果、正面成效、達標、突破或勝利。 因此替換前要先問：是在說 what was achieved, what outcome occurred, whether a target was met, whether an obstacle was overcome, or whether there was a contest with a winner？

options.explanation: Achievement ✓ — means a concrete success reached through effort, skill or persistence. Here, the sentence names a concrete accomplishment reached through effort. That makes Achievement the most precise replacement for this particular sense of success.

Accomplishment — means a task or goal successfully completed, often after effort. This is best for a concrete completed task; it is too specific for a general outcome or broader success state. The decisive clue is that the sentence names a concrete accomplishment reached through effort.

Positive result — means a beneficial or improving result. This focuses on a beneficial result and does not carry the same accomplishment, victory, or target-attainment nuance. The decisive clue is that the sentence names a concrete accomplishment reached through effort.

Effort — means work or energy put into trying and does not guarantee success. Effort describes what was put in, not whether the goal was achieved. The decisive clue is that the sentence names a concrete accomplishment reached through effort.

Progress — means movement towards a goal without necessarily reaching it. Progress means movement towards success, not necessarily successful completion. The decisive clue is that the sentence names a concrete accomplishment reached through effort.

Result — means an outcome that may be positive, negative or neutral. A result can be good, bad or neutral, so it does not guarantee success. The decisive clue is that the sentence names a concrete accomplishment reached through effort.

Achievement — means a concrete success reached through effort, skill or persistence. This is a concrete success and can be too accomplishment-focused for clinical outcomes or contest victories. The decisive clue is that an electoral contest has a clear winner.

Positive result — means a beneficial or improving result. This focuses on a beneficial result and does not carry the same accomplishment, victory, or target-attainment nuance. The decisive clue is that an electoral contest has a clear winner.

Victory ✓ — means success in a contest, election, battle, case or struggle. Here, an electoral contest has a clear winner. That makes Victory the most precise replacement for this particular sense of success.

Progress — means movement towards a goal without necessarily reaching it. Progress means movement towards success, not necessarily successful completion. The decisive clue is that an electoral contest has a clear winner.

Result — means an outcome that may be positive, negative or neutral. A result can be good, bad or neutral, so it does not guarantee success. The decisive clue is that an electoral contest has a clear winner.
